decision: Accept the bounded sizing calculation as a report-only diagnostic. Preserve V86 sizing and rejected ZEC/GOLD experiment dispositions. Next test the six exact executable contracts jointly with marked path and realistic execution costs before considering a cap change. This is fidelity research on opened historical data, not an untouched holdout.
falsifier: A mismatch with production sizing, provider-side overrides, venue fees, symbol ownership or profile identity invalidates the capacity report. Gaps, failed exits, liquidation and dynamic exit notional invalidate interpreting its static sensitivities as maximum losses. A later exact-contract replay may update economic conclusions.
hypothesis: Production provider-side caps, leverage and mutually exclusive symbol ownership determine executable exposure; configured asset margin fractions alone overstate deployed capacity.
limitations: No forecast of profitability or loss probability.
Metrics are independent one-position-per-symbol bounds and may maximize different route assignments.
Historical fees and equity are pinned to the September 5 15:30:46 UTC venue snapshot.
Current live performance remains unmeasured for several exact route identities.
ZEC exact capped replay was already completed in V84; the old wide-risk report is not the latest evidence.
